PASSAGE I

THE TERRACES · GOLDEN MORNING

Where the fields
follow the sun.

The river opens into golden terraces. Tiled rooftops gather beneath cherry blossoms; a small bridge crosses the morning.

Beyond the reeds,
a thousand small lives unfold.

水
PASSAGE II

THE FOREST · TWO SEASONS

Through green shadows,
a red leaf falls.

Bamboo rises on one bank. Autumn glows on the other. Ahead of us, the flock banks over a red bridge and follows the river into the gorge.

Nothing to hold.
Only the air beneath a wing.

風
PASSAGE III

THE HIGH PEAKS · SILVER WATER

Even the sky
has a way home.

The forest gives way to ink-blue peaks and white waterfalls. We rise with the flock, past the last pagoda, into the quiet above the valley.

Some journeys lead outward.
Some bring us back to ourselves.

Leave a little room
for wonder.
